notice: Change control for financial, safety and regulatory claims. It records required approvals; it is not a signed approval log or evidence that a claim is true.

rules: Every figure needs a dated assumption, definition, owner, source status, confidence and range.
Valuation figures are illustrative and non-offer.

safety.ownerRole: Chief AI Officer / Platform Security Lead
rules: AI action tiers, human release gates and responsible-drinking limits must remain fail-closed.
No safety check may be weakened without a named reviewer and test evidence.
No claim may imply a licence, regulator approval or active jurisdiction without evidence.
High-risk feature status only changes after signed legal/compliance review.

review.cadence: every financial, safety or regulatory claim change and quarterly

evidenceGaps: No populated change record, named individual approver or signed review is attached.
No external counsel opinion or regulator acknowledgement exists for any regulated claim.
